name: Offri
description:
Offri is proposal software that helps you close deals faster. Build professional, interactive proposals in minutes using reusable content blocks for your texts, pricing, and visuals, or let Offri AI draft a complete proposal from the client's briefing. Clients review and sign online, and you're notified the moment your proposal is opened, so you always know when to follow up.

This connector allows Claude to make changes to proposals, templates, components/products, and contacts. When activating the connector, you can choose to only give Claude access to certain modules. You can for example give read-only access to components.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Offri to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Offri to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.offri.app/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Offri MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Offri lists 40 MCP tools, including createCategory, createClient, createComponent, createContactPerson, createProposal, createTag, createUnit, deleteCategory, deleteClient, deleteComponent, deleteContactPerson, and deleteProposal.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Offri?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Offri in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Offri requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Offri is developed by Offri. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
